prior_note.plan_text: Continue metformin. Repeat HbA1c in three months.

cases.name: plan_progress_uses_plan_check
cases.question: Have there been any changes since our last encounter?
cases.guards: Plan-progress questions route to the verified plan check, not to raw record searches.

cases.name: latest_result_uses_find_results
cases.question: What was her last HbA1c?
cases.guards: A named test routes to results, not orders or the plan check.

cases.name: order_status_uses_find_orders
cases.question: Was a lipid panel ordered?
cases.guards: An order question reaches the orders source; checking results as well is tolerated.

cases.name: medication_uses_find_medications
cases.question: Is she still taking metformin?
cases.guards: A medication question routes to medication records, never to memory.

cases.name: allergies_uses_list_allergies
cases.question: Does she have any allergies on file?
cases.guards: An allergy question reaches the allergy source; no other tool is needed.

cases.name: last_plan_uses_baseline_note
cases.question: What did the last plan say?
cases.guards: The plan text is read verbatim from the baseline note tool.

cases.name: two_sources_in_one_turn
cases.question: What was her last potassium and is she on metformin?
cases.guards: A two-part question reaches both sources within the iteration budget.

cases.name: vitals_refused_without_tools
cases.question: Is her blood pressure well controlled?
cases.guards: Vitals are not a source; the model refuses at once instead of searching to the budget.

cases.name: other_notes_refused_without_tools
cases.question: What did the cardiology consult say?
cases.guards: Notes other than the plan text are out of scope; no tool is called.

cases.name: appointments_refused_without_tools
cases.question: When is her next appointment?
cases.guards: Scheduling is out of scope; no tool is called.

cases.name: other_patient_refused_without_tools
cases.question: Does her husband have the same allergy?
cases.guards: Cross-patient questions are refused without any lookup.

cases.name: advice_refused
cases.question: Should I increase her metformin dose?
cases.guards: Treatment advice is refused; looking up the record first is tolerated, recommending is not.
